title: Negro Folk Rhymes: Wise and Otherwise, With a Study
edition: New York: The Macmillan Company, 1922. Copyright 1922; Published January 1922.

edition_evidence.excerpt: New York / THE MACMILLAN COMPANY / 1922. Set up and printed. Published January, 1922.

rights_evidence.excerpt: Copyright: Public domain in the USA.
rights_evidence.scope: Exact supplied 1922 witness; official catalogue and title-page checked by browser 2026-10-08. No worldwide rights claim.

deduplication: Deferred to shared integration across this batch and existing corpus. Eligibility counts are not final import counts.
notes: Every Part I poem div is an audit candidate, including all 13 Foreign Section units. One untitled Philippine unit is identified by its printed section, without inventing a lyric title.

Native HTML entities/characters preserve macrons and breves; no respelling or pronunciation is invented. The documented ASCII [=a]/[)a] glyph convention has a tested decoder but is not the input extraction format.

Anonymous/traditional author attribution distinguishes collected words from compiler Thomas W. Talley; historical racial wording retained as printed, without equating every representation to an authentic uniform dialect.
Two mixed-language units are held on the Study’s explicit original-language evidence; this is English-only source eligibility, not a rejection of a dialect.

Old Man Know-All excluded because the Study explicitly identifies an unrecalled additional stanza. All other printed standalone English rhymes retained regardless of length; Frog Went A-Courting remains75 verse lines.

Footnotes/editorial notes retained in candidate evidence but excluded from sung text. Explicit spoken prose and speaker labels use existing # APPARATUS comments. Parenthetical verse is retained as printed.
Introduction and Study quoted verse, index and score-only duplicate headings are outside standalone Part I unit population, recorded in source-scope.json.

validation.source_pin: Original raw GitHub HTTP bytes retained in deterministic gzip; source SHA256 enforced by adapter.
validation.source_partition: 349 Part I poem divs, including336 main section and13 Foreign Section; asserted by adapter.
validation.stanza_boundaries: Each source div.stanza retained; each direct span.iN is a printed verse line. Inline styling removed without introducing intra-word spaces.
validation.offline_tests: test_data.py checks exact replay, diacritics, source partition, complete 75-line song, apparatus and explicit eligibility exclusions.
